requirements.title: Variables have definition status that changes by actions
requirements.source: S19.6.1 p1, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: A variable may be defined or undefined, definition status may change during execution, and becoming defined or undefined does not imply the previous status.

pending.variable-definition-status-changes: Initialize integer x to -777, execute x=42, and assert x==42; separate source-control plans for undefined status never read an undefined value.
pending.definition-event-no-prior-undefined-impl: Assign x=11 followed by x=22 with x initially defined, assert x==22, and mutate by deleting the second assignment.
pending.undefinition-event-no-prior-defined-impl: Source-control plan invokes a procedure with an INTENT(OUT) dummy actual that need not be read before the call; observe only a default-initialized subcomponent companion, never the undefined payload.

requirements.title: Objects have subobjects whose definition status participates in associations
requirements.source: S19.6.1 p2, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: Arrays, array sections, and derived, character, or complex variables consist of subobjects; associations may be established among variables and subobjects, and those subobjects may become defined or undefined.

pending.array-section-subobjects-can-be-defined: Initialize integer array a(3) to [-777,-778,-779], assign a(2:3)=[20,30], and assert the exact array value [-777,20,30] without reading an unassigned element as an oracle for definedness.
pending.derived-character-complex-subobjects: Assign derived component, character substring, and complex part sentinels to exact values 12, "XY", and real part 3.0, then assert each enclosing object or component path observes the assigned values.
pending.associated-subobjects-status-effects: Use EQUIVALENCE between character(len=4) whole and character(len=2) prefix, seed whole="abcd", assign prefix="WX", and assert whole=="WXcd".

requirements.title: Array definition requires all elements to be defined
requirements.source: S19.6.1 p3, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: An array is defined exactly in the case that all of its elements are defined.

pending.array-defined-after-all-elements-defined: Initialize all elements of integer a(3) to [-1,-2,-3], assign every element [4,5,6], pass a to an INTENT(IN) checker, and assert SUM(a)==15 exactly.
pending.array-not-observable-with-undefined-elem: No portable oracle reads an array containing an undefined element; future negative evidence must use source-status reasoning or a companion element later made defined.

requirements.title: Derived-type scalar definition depends on all nonpointer components
requirements.source: S19.6.1 p4, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: A derived-type scalar object is defined exactly in the case that all nonpointer components are defined.

pending.derived-scalar-defined-after-nonpointer-: Define a type with integer and character nonpointer components plus a pointer component; assign integer=77 and character="Q", leave pointer disassociated, and assert a checker using only nonpointer components succeeds.
pending.pointer-components-do-not-control-object: Initialize nonpointer components to sentinels 8 and "Z", keep the pointer component NULL(), and assert assignment of the whole object to another variable preserves the nonpointer values.

requirements.title: Complex and character scalar definition depends on all subobjects
requirements.source: S19.6.1 p5, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: A complex or character scalar object is defined exactly in the case that all of its subobjects are defined.

pending.complex-defined-after-both-parts-defined: Initialize complex z to (-777.0,-778.0), assign z=CMPLX(3.0,4.0), and assert REAL(z)==3.0 and AIMAG(z)==4.0 exactly representable.
pending.character-defined-after-all-characters-d: Initialize character(len=4) c="zzzz", assign c(1:2)="AB" then c(3:4)="CD", and assert c=="ABCD".
